converter.name: Atomsk
converter.info:
Atomsk binaries compiled for 64-bit Linux and MacOS systems are distributed with this package. It may be registered on other systems by compiling it locally and adding the compiled 'atomsk' binary (with this exact name - rename it or make a symbolic link to it if necessary) to your $PATH.

Its corresponding source code may be found at https://github.com/pierrehirel/atomsk/
